remarks: An exceptional opportunity in Rowayton's highly sought-after RBA! 31 Craw offers coveted access to the private Rowayton Beach Association beach and boathouse, all just steps from town, restaurants and shops. This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home provides a functional layout on each level. Enter through the welcoming foyer or attached 2-car garage into an open and bright first floor. Enjoying soaring ceilings, a gas fireplace, and easy access to the backyard in the main living space. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite is a true retreat, featuring dual walk-in closets. There are two additional large bedrooms and a full bathroom. The top floor offers a fourth bedroom plus additional flex space-perfect for a home office, playroom, gym, or guest room. Don't miss another full bath on the third floor. The outdoor space is a standout feature-31 Craw has an unusually generous yard space for the RBA, perfect for entertaining, relaxing, and throwing a lacrosse ball. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live in the heart of our favorite coastal town in Fairfield County.
